Executive Vision & Aesthetic Protocol

The Anatomy of Sovereign Quiet Luxury

Sarrin Holidays rejects generic mass-market tourism and AI-generated template styling. The brand aesthetic is engineered around restrained quiet luxury, architectural typography, frosted glassmorphism, and heritage Indian palatial hospitality under strict discretion covenants.

Human Craftsmanship Directives

Zero Emojis Everywhere: Strict prohibition of casual emoji symbols across all consumer views and forms.
Minimal Dot Bullets (•): SaaS checkmark boxes replaced with understated luxury dots.
Restrained Human Copywriting: Concise, readable, tailored travel desk liaison messaging instead of verbose AI fluff.
Discrete Pricing Protocol: "Pricing on Request" reflecting custom palace suite buyouts and private aviation routing.

Out-of-the-Box Concierge Lead Routing Flow

When a traveler enters a destination outside published catalogs (e.g., “Nashik”, “Coorg”, “Kaziranga”), the search bar instantly adapts into a bespoke concierge inquiry trigger:

Desk Prompt: "We arrange custom private travel to “Nashik”. Connect with our desk to plan your itinerary."
CTA Action: [Request a call for detailed suggestions for Nashik] → Direct forward to VIP Operations Manifest.

Responsive Glassmorphic Ergonomics

On desktop, the search bar spans 768px with horizontal divisions and frosted blur (`backdrop-blur-2xl`). On mobile viewports (< 768px), it collapses gracefully into a stacked vertical thumb-friendly panel with zero horizontal overflow, preventing viewport clipping.

Package Card Ergonomics & Quality Standards

Non-Wrapping Duration Pill

Duration badges (e.g. `8 Days / 7 Nights`) utilize strict `whitespace-nowrap` & `shrink-0` to guarantee pills never collapse into circles.

Subtle Scarcity Notice

Curator notes like "Special Edition" or "Houseboat Allotted" are truncated cleanly with golden accents without squeezing header cards.

Direct Inquire Routing

"Pricing on Request" paired with "Get in Touch" buttons opens high-touch VIP dossier modal directly linked to CRM inquiries.

Sarrin Holidays Atelier Section 09 // Production Architecture
Technical Architecture & Infrastructure

Production Deployment & Operations Blueprint

Sarrin Holidays is engineered as an enterprise-grade cloud application with zero single-point-of-failure dependencies, strict TypeScript typing, and automated process management.

Frontend & Framework Engine

Framework: Next.js 16.3.3 (Turbopack Engine)
Runtime: React 19 + TypeScript 5.7.3
Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + Framer Motion 13
Typecheck Audit: 0 Compiler Errors (`tsc --noEmit`)
Static Optimization: 30/30 Canonical Routes Statically Generated

Cloud Database & Security

Database: Supabase PostgreSQL (AWS ap-south-1)
Tables: packages (9), services (4), tours (3), inquiries (11)
Access Control: Row Level Security (RLS) policies
Admin Security: Middleware auth guard on `/admin/*`
Integrations: Resend SMTP & Encrypted Webhooks

Live Deployment Specifications

Live Production URL: https://sarrin.bidvyapar.com
Production Server: OVHcloud Singapore (15.235.251.215) • Ubuntu Linux 7.0 LTS
Dedicated App Directory: /opt/projects/sarrinholidays
Process Manager (PM2): App Name: `sarrinholidays` (Port 999, Cluster Mode, Auto-restart)
Network Gateway: Cloudflare Tunnel (`cloudflared-root`) with Edge SSL & DDoS Protection
Git Remote Repository: https://github.com/bidvyapar-eng/sarrinholidays_git.git (main branch)
